destination.title: CFT structure, spectra, phases and holographic realization
destination.question: How do CFT data and constructions constrain possible theories, spectra, continuous families, thermal phases and holographic descriptions?
destination.summary: This is a heterogeneous proposed family. Intrinsic CFT questions coexist with construction problems and conditional holographic tests; their proximity does not establish equivalence or transfer assumptions between them.

systems: CFTs in the dimensions specified by each source
Candidate holographic CFTs and their proposed bulk descriptions
Nonconformal cascading plasma as a boundary case
targets: Relevant scalar deformations and scalar gaps
Existence and origins of nonsupersymmetric fixed points
Marginality, coupling-space geometry and spectral degeneration
Thermal spectral growth and heavy-tower existence
Conditional brane decoupling and scale separation
regimes: Weak coupling, strong coupling, large N and large central charge remain distinct
Overall free points and partial-decoupling limits remain distinct
Finite temperature and nonconformal high-temperature limits remain distinct
assumptions: Premises are source-specific; numerical membership supplies none
conventions: CFT dimension, gap type, distance normalization and bulk cutoff must retain their source meanings
includes: Alternate holographic construction and decoupling homes
excludes: A universal CFT or Swampland exclusion claim
Automatic equivalence of scalar gaps, higher-spin gaps and scale separation
Automatic identification of stabilized bulk moduli with exactly marginal CFT couplings

sources.title: Universal Spectrum of 2d Conformal Field Theory in the Large c Limit

evidence.text: Which restrictions on the light spectrum of a large-c two-dimensional CFT make its leading thermal free energy universal and extend Cardy entropy from the fixed-c asymptotic regime to energies of order c? What remains undetermined at intermediate energies and finite angular potential?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilisation and the Holographic Swampland

evidence.text: Can CFT consistency require a heavy tower rather than constrain its couplings after its existence is assumed? The source identifies this existence problem as a distinct missing part of the proposed distance-conjecture connection.

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: The two allowed quantizations test whether thermal order depends on operator dimension. Removing the source mode allows a nonzero retained condensate to represent spontaneous Z2 breaking.

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: How can a thermal conformal state carry spontaneous order? The order parameter scales as T^Δ, while energy density, pressure, and entropy obey the conformal equation of state without an independent dimensionful deformation.

sources.title: A CFT distance conjecture

evidence.text: The objects being compared are families of unitary local CFTs with finite stress-tensor normalization. Their coupling-space geometry is measured by two-point functions of exactly marginal local operators.

sources.title: A CFT distance conjecture

evidence.text: How does the geometry of a family of conformal field theories constrain the spectrum of local operators? Degeneration limits offer a setting in which a spectral gap might diagnose an infinite geodesic distance.

sources.title: The quest for a conifold conformal order

evidence.text: Does the conifold supply a string-theory realization of persistent thermal order in a four-dimensional CFT, with a controlled bulk description?

sources.title: The quest for a conifold conformal order

evidence.text: Can a nonconformal cascading plasma approach a genuinely ordered conformal phase when its intrinsic scale becomes negligible relative to temperature?

sources.title: Universal bounds on CFT Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Does a vanishing primary dimension force infinite Zamolodchikov distance in a two-dimensional unitary CFT, with universal exponential rates and an emergent geometric sector?

sources.title: Modular invariance as completeness

evidence.text: How do generalized symmetries or violations of Haag duality appear in local CFT data? In two dimensions, can modular invariance characterize completeness, and can partition functions and entropies quantify its failure?

sources.title: Continuous Family of Conformal Field Theories and Exactly Marginal Operators

evidence.text: Does a continuous family of CFTs necessarily possess exactly marginal operators, and can those operators be reconstructed from interfaces connecting nearby theories?

sources.title: Group Theory and the CFT Distance Conjecture: $\mathcal{N}=2$ Tensionless Strings Have No (Co)Weight

evidence.text: Which group-theoretic data determine Hagedorn growth at the overall free point of large-N four-dimensional N=2 Lagrangian SCFTs, and how do these data constrain CFT Distance Conjecture rates in partial-decoupling limits?

sources.title: The String landscape and the swampland

evidence.text: Must a CFT with a discrete operator spectrum have a finite-volume moduli space? The proposed criterion is motivated by bulk scalar finiteness and supported qualitatively by known two- and four-dimensional superconformal examples.

sources.title: Nonsupersymmetric conformal field theories from stable anti-de Sitter spaces

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry-breaking relevant deformations of known holographic CFTs reach new interacting infrared CFTs, and which candidate AdS endpoints survive classical stability tests?

sources.title: Universal Spectrum of 2d Conformal Field Theory in the Large c Limit

evidence.text: Finite-angular-potential bounds are improved by iterating between canonical and spectral constraints, including numerical minimization of a quartic problem. Symmetric-product spectra are studied through generating functions, Hecke transforms and a long-string sector that saturates an entropy bound.

sources.title: Moduli Stabilisation and the Holographic Swampland

evidence.text: Match a physical mass power to the canonical quadratic action, infer the kinetic metric, convert volume powers to field exponentials, and expand around a reference vacuum. The output applies only within the diagonal-sector, fixed-prefactor, leading-volume ansatz.

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: Insert a scalar potential into the radial system and impose regular horizon data and a source-free boundary condition. The source reports the reduction; the analytical checks below verify vacuum normalization and leading scalar limits without certifying every nonlinear metric term.

sources.title: A CFT distance conjecture

evidence.text: Match scalar and stress-tensor two-point functions across AdS/CFT, retaining all source prefactors. Convert a boundary gap exponent to a bulk mass exponent using m² ∝ γ and the Planck-normalized scalar metric.

sources.title: The quest for a conifold conformal order

evidence.text: Continue a nonlinear gravitational solution family and monitor both numerical boundary-data growth and a local curvature invariant. The operation tests whether a proposed limiting construction remains within its effective description.

sources.title: Universal bounds on CFT Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: The upper-bound argument uses crossing of light-operator four-point functions, global conformal blocks, positivity, OPE convergence, and contour projection functionals. The emergent-sector argument uses light-operator OPEs and current algebra; the lower bound uses an eigenvalue estimate.

sources.title: Perturbative search for dead-end CFTs

evidence.text: Can CFTs have no physical relevant scalar deformations without imposing symmetry protection, thereby permitting self-organized criticality? The search concerns nontrivial examples among weakly coupled, power-counting renormalizable theories in three and four dimensions.

sources.title: AdS Field Theory from Conformal Field Theory

evidence.text: Which bottom-up properties of CFT correlators guarantee a perturbative AdS effective field theory with a cutoff parametrically above the curvature scale, and what constraints follow for conserved higher-spin interactions?

sources.title: AdS$_{8}$ solutions in type II supergravity

evidence.text: Can non-supersymmetric AdS8 compactifications provide string-theoretic evidence for unitary interacting seven-dimensional CFTs, beyond the dimensions admitting superconformal theories?

sources.title: Bifundamental multiscalar fixed points in <math display="inline"><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>ε</mi></math>

evidence.text: Can sextic bifundamental scalar theories furnish strongly interacting, nonsupersymmetric planar large-N CFTs, particularly an IR theory in d=2 or a UV theory in d=3?

sources.title: The Conformal Bootstrap

evidence.text: How can conformal symmetry, unitarity and OPE consistency constrain strongly coupled CFTs without choosing a microscopic Lagrangian? These pedagogical lectures develop the foundations and introduce numerical applications to the 2d and 3d Ising models.

sources.title: Double-Trace Flows and the Swampland

evidence.text: Could every nonsupersymmetric large-gap CFT descend from a supersymmetric parent through an RG flow? The source raises this conditional alternative without a classification argument.

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: Can consistency of three-dimensional CFTs exclude AdS₄ vacua with a parametrically heavy lightest scalar? The proposed investigation concerns theories without relevant deformations, with strongly coupled possibilities explicitly unresolved.

sources.title: Comments on a state-operator correspondence for the torus

evidence.text: Can states of a three-dimensional CFT on a spatial two-torus admit a bijective state-operator correspondence based on compact Euclidean fillings? The central necessary test is whether such a filling can prepare the torus vacuum.

sources.title: Conserved Charges in Asymptotically (Locally) AdS Spacetimes

evidence.text: How do boundary conditions and asymptotic symmetries define conserved charges in asymptotically locally AdS gravity, how do these charges relate to Hamiltonian generators, and what boundary observables underlie AdS/CFT?

sources.title: Holography at finite cutoff with a $T^2$ deformation

evidence.text: Which irrelevant deformation of a large-N CFT reproduces AdS gravity with a finite radial Dirichlet wall, including matter sources and correlation functions?

sources.title: Gauge theory correlators from noncritical string theory

evidence.text: Can boundary-condition dependence of an AdS supergravity action generate large-N N=4 Yang–Mills correlators and predict strong-coupling dimensions of operators coupled to excited string states?

sources.title: Bulk versus boundary dynamics in anti-de Sitter space-time

evidence.text: How should Lorentzian AdS/CFT accommodate tunable boundary sources and the normalizable modes required for Hamiltonian quantization, and how much local bulk dynamics can its boundary generating functional describe?

sources.title: The Holographic Weyl anomaly

evidence.text: For CFTs described by the conjectured AdS/CFT correspondence, how does the effective action depend on the chosen representative of the boundary conformal metric, and what Weyl anomaly follows from covariantly regularizing the bulk gravitational action?

sources.title: A Stress tensor for Anti-de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: How can one define a finite boundary stress tensor and conserved gravitational charges for asymptotically locally AdS spacetimes without requiring a reference-space embedding, while recovering stress-tensor properties expected from the proposed dual CFT?

sources.title: Conserved Charges in Asymptotically (Locally) AdS Spacetimes

evidence.text: Fefferman–Graham radial expansion solves the field equations recursively. In vacuum, γ^(0) and constrained γ^(d) provide free asymptotic data; lower coefficients are locally determined. Even boundary dimension generally requires a z^d log(z²) term.

sources.title: Holography at finite cutoff with a $T^2$ deformation

evidence.text: On flat backgrounds, introduce a symmetric Hubbard-Stratonovich field to interpret the deformation as averaging over metric perturbations. Its saddle, assuming a large classical stress tensor, matches radial metric evolution.

sources.title: Gauge theory correlators from noncritical string theory

evidence.text: Extract operator dimensions from leading nonanalytic momentum dependence, discarding analytic powers for this purpose. Extend the scalar analysis to S5 partial waves and to massive spacetime scalars, where the Bessel index is ν=√(4+m²R²).

sources.title: Bulk versus boundary dynamics in anti-de Sitter space-time

evidence.text: Use a background-field path integral Φ = Φcl + δΦ: fixed source data determine a classical background, while fluctuations are integrated over. Hamiltonian mode selection uses the Klein–Gordon inner product, conserved boundary flux and vanishing energy exchange.

sources.title: The Holographic Weyl anomaly

evidence.text: Use Fefferman–Graham coordinates and solve Einstein's equations near the conformal boundary as an expansion in ρ. For even d, the expansion requires a ρ^(d/2) logρ term. Lower coefficients and the trace of g_(d) are covariant boundary expressions, although the full g_(d) is not.

sources.title: A Stress tensor for Anti-de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: Starting from the Brown–York variation, T^{μν} = 2(−γ)^(−1/2) δS/δγμν, the authors add intrinsic boundary counterterms. The resulting tensor is (8πG)⁻¹[Θ^{μν}−Θγ^{μν}+2(−γ)^(−1/2)δSct/δγμν]. On shell, only boundary terms enter the action variation.

sources.title: Conformal Anomalies and Generalised Energy Conservation in De Sitter Spacetime

evidence.text: For discrete-series bulk fields with integer boundary dimensions, how does Generalised Energy Conservation (GEC) in extended-Poincaré de Sitter scattering relate to boundary conformal anomalies and holographic renormalisability, and which contact interactions satisfy each condition?

sources.title: Do holographic CFT states have unique semiclassical bulk duals?

evidence.text: Can one fixed holographic CFT state have two simple semiclassical bulk descriptions differing by the presence of a closed universe? Which bulk-boundary dictionary and inner product then describe an observer's experience?

sources.title: Remark about dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can Witten's modified de Sitter inner product, together with a conjectured identification of bulk initial states and boundary CFT states, determine boundary correlators without an explicit realization of dS/CFT?

sources.title: Partition Functions of Three-Dimensional Pure Gravity

evidence.text: Can genus-two partition functions of extremal CFTs at general c = 24k be constructed consistently and uniquely, and can gravitational instanton sums reproduce them, conditional on those CFTs existing?

sources.title: Nonlinear Laplace equation, de Sitter vacua, and information geometry

evidence.text: What do exact, nonperturbative solutions of critical interacting scalar theories reveal about AdS/CFT, the information geometry of solution moduli, and classical scalar descriptions on de Sitter backgrounds?

sources.title: On the holographic S matrix

evidence.text: Can the ordinary S-matrix of an interacting massless scalar theory in five-dimensional Minkowski spacetime be recovered from timelike-boundary data of a bulk AdS theory in the flat-space limit? The paper emphasizes that the answer depends on what bulk quantization is intended.

sources.title: Swampland conditions for higher derivative couplings from CFT

evidence.text: How are bulk scalar couplings translated into boundary correlators with the numerical normalization needed for coupling bounds?

sources.title: Further Evidence Against a Semiclassical Baby Universe in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can the same CFT state consistently encode a semiclassical disconnected baby universe and a bulk without one, while retaining the conventional extrapolate dictionary and causal-wedge encoding?

sources.title: Anti de Sitter space and holography

evidence.text: How can boundary conformal-field-theory observables be computed from bulk supergravity or string theory, including operator dimensions, protected spectra and large-N thermodynamics?

sources.title: The dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can asymptotic symmetries and scalar boundary correlators support a holographic description of de Sitter quantum gravity by a Euclidean CFT, determine its central charge in three dimensions, and explain how bulk time and the two asymptotic boundaries are encoded?

sources.title: Negative energy, superluminosity and holography

evidence.text: How can boundary SYM encode distant bulk collisions before their signals reach the boundary, while its stress tensor subsequently exhibits apparently instantaneous redistribution, superluminal oscillations and negative local energy?

sources.title: Towards a holographic description of closed universes

evidence.text: Can AS2 baby universes and Maldacena–Maoz closed universes be described by boundary operator algebras and states within AdS/CFT, and can an appropriate large-N limit resolve the apparent absence of a semiclassical baby-universe sector?

sources.title: Lorentzian AdS, Wormholes and Holography

evidence.text: How should Lorentzian GKPW compute correlators with two independent asymptotic boundaries, and when do mixed-boundary correlations indicate interactions, entanglement, or both?

sources.title: Codimension two holography for wedges

evidence.text: Can gravity on a (d+1)-dimensional AdS wedge admit a codimension-two CFT dual on its (d−1)-dimensional corner, and do free energy, anomaly, entanglement and scalar-spectrum calculations support that proposal? A second question concerns Lorentzian wedges dual to spacelike CFT boundaries.

sources.title: Gauge-invariant observables, gravitational dressings, and holography in AdS

evidence.text: How can diffeomorphism-invariant observables be constructed perturbatively in AdS, and how far do gravitational constraints and a boundary Hamiltonian explain an equal-time bulk-to-boundary holographic map?

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Can HST satisfy moving-observer overlap constraints and explicitly relate its AdS tensor networks to CFT and proper-time dynamics?

sources.title: A Comment on multiple vacua, particle production and the time dependent AdS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: How should Lorentzian AdS/CFT encode multiple natural vacua in time-dependent backgrounds, and how does cosmological particle production relate bulk and boundary in-in versus in-out correlators?

sources.title: Time-dependent spacetimes in AdS/CFT: Bubble and black hole

evidence.text: How do horizons, thermodynamics and de Sitter vacuum ambiguities in the AdS bubble of nothing and locally AdS black hole map to their boundary CFT?

sources.title: The inside outs of AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$: exact AdS wormholes with entangled CFT duals

evidence.text: Can independent stress-tensor data at two asymptotically AdS3 boundaries be completed into exact geometries with smooth horizons and wormhole interiors, and identified with explicit entangled CFT2 states through observable matching?

sources.title: Holographic representation of local bulk operators

evidence.text: How are free local bulk fields represented by nonlocal CFT operators in Lorentzian AdS/CFT, how sharply can their boundary support be localized, and what does this suggest about finite-N locality and holographic counting?

sources.title: A Study of Quantum Field Theories in AdS at Finite Coupling

evidence.text: How can finite-coupling QFT observables on AdS connect boundary conformal correlators, flat-space scattering and BCFT data, while exposing nonperturbative spectral phenomena through large-N resummation?

sources.title: The Holographic bound in anti-de Sitter space

evidence.text: How does AdS/CFT implement the holographic information bound, beyond identifying a gravitational bulk theory with a boundary theory, when both boundary area and boundary entropy are initially infinite?

How can one define a finite boundary stress tensor and conserved gravitational charges for asymptotically locally AdS spacetimes without requiring a reference-space embedding, while recovering stress-tensor properties expected from the proposed dual CFT?

sources.title: Constructing local bulk observables in interacting AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can CFT operators represent interacting bulk observables beyond leading large N while satisfying bulk locality, defined as commutation at spacelike separation?

sources.title: Bulk and Transhorizon Measurements in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can effective bulk observables, including measurements behind an AdS black-hole horizon, be represented in the dual CFT? In particular, can the CFT encode a measurement distinguishing a live from a dead cat behind the horizon?

sources.title: Construction of Bulk Fields with Gauge Redundancy

evidence.text: How can boundary-operator smearing reconstruct gauge and gravitational bulk fields, and what physical meaning and locality remain after gauge fixing and imposing Gauss-law constraints?

sources.title: Holographic representation of bulk fields with spin in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can bulk spin-one and spin-two fields be represented as smeared CFT operators, and which notions of locality survive gauge redundancy, interactions in 1/N perturbation theory, and extensions beyond a fixed AdS background?

sources.title: The Gravity Dual of a Density Matrix

evidence.text: Given a boundary subregion density matrix ρ_A in a state with a classical geometric AdS/CFT dual, what is the largest bulk region fully reconstructible from it, equivalently common to all geometric duals compatible with that density matrix?

sources.title: CFT representation of interacting bulk gauge fields in AdS

evidence.text: How can interacting AdS gauge fields and charged matter be reconstructed from CFT observables while imposing the microcausality compatible with gauge constraints and Wilson-line dressing?

sources.title: Decoding the hologram: Scalar fields interacting with gravity

evidence.text: How can smeared CFT operators represent an AdS scalar interacting with gravity while satisfying the appropriate spacelike commutation relations and transforming correctly under AdS isometries?

sources.title: Bulk Locality and Quantum Error Correction in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can approximate bulk locality, especially radial locality and reconstruction on overlapping boundary regions, emerge when the full CFT operator algebra cannot obey the apparent bulk commutation relations?

sources.title: Further Holographic Investigations of Big Bang Singularities

evidence.text: Can boundary two-point functions identify the Kasner-AdS initial singularity, and what does their behavior imply about the CFT state selected by the geodesic approximation?

sources.title: Gauge-invariant observables, gravitational dressings, and holography in AdS

evidence.text: How can diffeomorphism-invariant observables be constructed perturbatively in AdS, and how far do gravitational constraints and a boundary Hamiltonian explain an equal-time bulk-to-boundary holographic map?

sources.title: A physical protocol for observers near the boundary to obtain bulk information in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can observers confined near the entire boundary of global AdS identify a low-energy bulk quantum state using simple unitary manipulations and measurements restricted to a short time band?

sources.title: Bulk reconstruction in rotating BTZ black hole

evidence.text: How can a scalar field in rotating BTZ be represented by boundary CFT operators outside and inside the outer horizon, especially near the inner Cauchy horizon? What changes when interior reconstruction uses state-dependent mirror operators on a single boundary?

sources.title: Emergent Times in Holographic Duality

evidence.text: Can boundary operators generate emergent infalling evolutions that carry bulk Cauchy slices behind an eternal AdS black-hole horizon, while exposing its interior and causal structure?

sources.title: Holographic representation of local bulk operators

evidence.text: How are free local bulk fields represented by nonlocal CFT operators in Lorentzian AdS/CFT, how sharply can their boundary support be localized, and what does this suggest about finite-N locality and holographic counting?

sources.title: Constructing local bulk observables in interacting AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Add appropriately smeared higher-dimension primaries built from normal-ordered products and derivatives. Determine coefficients by canceling successive powers of an invariant commutator expansion; in AdS2 the tower is resummed into a bilocal correction.

sources.title: Bulk and Transhorizon Measurements in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Invert the extrapolate dictionary using Green's theorem, finite-global-time Green functions with spacelike/null support and perturbative iteration of interacting bulk equations. Ordinary Cauchy evolution and CFT time evolution convert bulk operators into single-time nonlocal boundary precursors.

sources.title: Construction of Bulk Fields with Gauge Redundancy

evidence.text: Interpret fixed-gauge fields through boundary-anchored Wilson lines or geodesically defined positions. Canonically quantize Maxwell theory after imposing generalized Coulomb gauge, solve the elliptic constraint using Fourier/Bessel Green functions and obtain nonlocal equal-time commutators.

sources.title: Holographic representation of bulk fields with spin in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: In holographic gauge, reduce zAμ to scalar equations with effective m²R² = 1−d and dimension Δ = d−1; reduce z²hμν to massless scalar equations with Δ = d. Fourier-Bessel mode expansions yield the corresponding smearing distributions.

sources.title: The Gravity Dual of a Density Matrix

evidence.text: Derive consistency constraints using boundary domains of dependence, deterministic bulk field equations and independent variations of disjoint boundary density matrices. Compare candidate regions against causal upper bounds and explicit geometrical examples.

sources.title: CFT representation of interacting bulk gauge fields in AdS

evidence.text: CFT reconstruction smears operators over complexified boundary coordinates, expresses three-point functions through hypergeometric functions of an AdS invariant, and uses large-N factorization to evaluate higher-dimension operator corrections.

sources.title: Bulk versus boundary dynamics in anti-de Sitter space-time

evidence.text: How should Lorentzian AdS/CFT accommodate tunable boundary sources and the normalizable modes required for Hamiltonian quantization, and how much local bulk dynamics can its boundary generating functional describe?

sources.title: AdS dynamics from conformal field theory

evidence.text: To what extent can local bulk string and supergravity dynamics be recovered from CFT operators, particularly beyond the free large-N limit, and what can this description say about black-hole infall, complementarity, and the BTZ singularity?

sources.title: Looking for a bulk point

evidence.text: Which Lorentzian correlator singularities diagnose a local AdS bulk, how do boundary perturbation theory and the OPE account for them, and which singularities survive string corrections or the exact theory?

sources.title: Negative energy, superluminosity and holography

evidence.text: How can boundary SYM encode distant bulk collisions before their signals reach the boundary, while its stress tensor subsequently exhibits apparently instantaneous redistribution, superluminal oscillations and negative local energy?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Emergence of Bulk Physics in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How does local bulk effective field theory emerge from a CFT, which CFTs support it, and where does it fail? These review lectures emphasize Lorentzian physics at fixed time and the route from quantum error correction to entanglement-wedge reconstruction.

sources.title: Eternal black holes in anti-de Sitter

evidence.text: How can the maximally extended Schwarzschild-AdS spacetime, including its interior, be described nonperturbatively, and how can its exponentially decaying semiclassical correlators be reconciled with boundary unitarity?

sources.title: Rindler bulk reconstruction and subregion duality in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can CFT operators supported in a boundary subregion reconstruct all local bulk fields in its AdS-Rindler wedge, once the distinction between a UV-complete free field and finite-N quantum gravity is retained?
